correctness.rationale: Pure adjacency and equality encode distances capped at two. For ordered triples the five coordinate patterns capture exactly the possible next-symbol choices, and the corresponding capped distance vectors combine by associative capped addition. Pair orbits are indexed by Hamming distance, and vertex transitivity reduces the last recursion to the set of pair types from a fixed vertex. An independent implementation (`cd /workspace && python3 audit-evidence/hamming.py`) checked all 378 singleton-state transition identities and exhaustively compared the types in dimensions 1 through 14 for alphabets 2, 3, and 4. It recovered the sixteen classes, including all cross-alphabet inequalities. The infinite reduction is exact: truncating bin counts at positive caps preserves all profiles beyond the sum of the caps, since excess coordinates can be absorbed by a saturated bin. Pair profiles are thus clipped at (6,8) or (5,9), whose caps sum to 14, so all dimensions at least 14 realize the same set of clipped profiles. At most four distinct symbols per coordinate can be used in four rounds, giving the alphabet tail. These facts also establish sharpness of the 1024-vertex bound within the family; the independent check does not rely on the record's reported runs.
